stem: Jatin must remove the brackets in $12-(7-3)$.

options.text: Negative sign before brackets means the word "brackets" alone.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A minus before the brackets changes the signs inside, so $-(7-3)$ becomes $-7+3$.

teacher.key_rationale: Removing brackets after a minus flips inner signs: 12-(7-3)=12-7+3. Calling the minus the word 'brackets' swaps terms. Writing 12-7-3 omits the sign-change condition.
